fixed_candidate_contract.timeframe: M15 reconstructed from source-native Bid ticks
fixed_candidate_contract.atr_method: rolling mean of true range in pips
fixed_candidate_contract.short_signal: prior ts<=-1 and current High>=EMA20-tolerance and current Close<EMA20 and current Close<current Open
fixed_candidate_contract.entry: first source-native executable Bid at or after next observed M15 boundary
fixed_candidate_contract.exit_boundary: 16 observed M15 bars after entry boundary
fixed_candidate_contract.exit: first source-native executable Ask at or after 16 observed M15 bars
fixed_candidate_contract.same_variant_active_suppression: reject signal index i when i<=prior accepted i+17
fixed_candidate_contract.duplicate_handling: one accepted event per exact signal boundary after active suppression; duplicate event count must be zero
